Simply if the price closes below the MA it is time to sell. Obviously if the period you are looking at is long term you would probably use a weekly or even monthly chart and use a relatively large period MA such as a 50 week or 100 week moving average. The idea for timing the markets in the long term is to buy when the indicator crosses above the zero line and sell when it crosses below the zero line.
